floater.name: floater_sknav_annotate
floater.title: Navmesh annotations
floater.floater.string: Pick a type to place it; while placing, the key on each button switches to it. A mark selected below takes a type of its own shape.
Placing [TYPE]: click along it; Enter or a double-click ends the line, Esc cancels.
Placing [TYPE]: hover a portal the Spaces layer draws and click to strike it out; click a struck one to restore it. The Spaces checkbox in the navmesh console must be on.
Picking an exit for the selected stair: click where the way up lands; Esc lets go.

panel.name: type_grid
panel.tool_tip: The type the next marks get, and the selected mark's

line_editor.name: mark_text
line_editor.label: Note for the selected mark
line_editor.tool_tip: The selected mark's note; Enter keeps it

panel.name: stair_row
panel.tool_tip: A stair can serve several floors and can wind; pick a stair to work its ways

button.name: add_exit
button.label: Add exit
button.tool_tip: The next surface click adds a way up where the selected stair lands beyond its own top

check_box.name: spiral
check_box.label: Spiral
check_box.tool_tip: Wind the selected stair as a helix about an axis instead of running it straight; the handles then set axis, radius and rise

spinner.name: spiral_turns
spinner.label: Turns
spinner.tool_tip: How many turns of the helix the spiral's climb takes, a quarter at a time

check_box.name: spiral_left
check_box.label: Left-hand
check_box.tool_tip: Wind the spiral the other way about its axis
